title: Urdais Grid Buildout Velocity — GBV-1 external research
status: internal research; establishes no legal right; does not write code, ingest data, or compute a velocity metric
product_policy_note: ambiguous_requires_legal_review may be publicly displayed under founder-accepted legal risk while preserving classification. unsuitable_without_permission remains blocked without explicit permission. That overlay does not change classifications in this file.
intended_concept: How fast the physical transmission system is being built or completed. Not generation waiting in queue, operational transfer margin, or whether future demand exceeds approved capacity.

quantity_comparability.reason: Project grain, inclusion thresholds, rebuild vs greenfield, and published scale fields differ. CAISO TDF has no cost. ISO-NE list has no miles. Transfer MW is not a tracker field.

candidate_metrics.why: Native completed/in-service events exist. Counts are not cross-market comparable.
CAISO TDF and ISO-NE lists lack a complete mile column. Rebuild vs new corridor often mixed.
CAISO TDF explicitly excludes cost. Nominal dollars are not physical velocity.
ERCOT has no mandated approval-date column. PJM actual ISD not confirmed. NYISO n is too small.
Construction start is not a published portfolio field in the other six.

where: SPP Need Date vs owner ISD
candidate_metrics.why: Need Date is not original expected ISD. ISO-NE appendix has no frozen original ISD.
Requires frozen entry-year rules plus archives. SPP Closed Out drop and ERCOT RPG exclusion bias denominators.
Native Under Construction / Construction counts only. PJM public chart was stale. Not a MW backlog.
No seven-market voltage+quantity census. Voltage often lives in names. Net vs gross unpublished.
